name: mestre-pratico
title: Mestre Prático & NutriPreço - Oráculo Soberano da Economia Real Brasileira
description: Barramento Semântico e Oráculo Oficial de Preços de Combustíveis (ANP), Medicamentos (CMED/ANVISA), Cesta Básica (Decreto 11.936/2024), Poder de Compra, Tarifas Elétricas (ANEEL), Frete (ANTT) e Liquidação A2A. Operado pela Holding Arthur Luis Vieira dos Santos.

publisher.name: TECNOLOGIA E INTELIGÊNCIA DE VAREJO INOVA SIMPLES I.S. (Holding Arthur Luis Vieira dos Santos)

authentication.rate_limit: 60 requests per minute for public queries

compliance.data_integrity: RULE[user_global] - Zero synthetic data, audited primary sources (ANP, CMED, SEFAZ, BACEN, ANEEL, ANTT)
compliance.security: Edge Semantic WAF (Anti-Prompt-Injection with HTTP 403 enforcement)

tools.name: brazil_fuel_prices
tools.description: Queries real-time audited retail fuel prices across all 27 Brazilian Federative Units (UFs) and 417+ cities from Brazil's National Petroleum Agency (ANP).

tools.name: brazil_grocery_basket
tools.description: Queries audited retail prices of Brazil's official basic food basket (Cesta Básica Nacional) under Federal Decree No. 11.936/2024 across Brazilian capital cities.

tools.name: brazil_purchasing_power_oracle
tools.description: Calculates real purchasing power metrics and labor-hours required to purchase essential commodities across all 27 Brazilian states using official minimum wage (R$ 1.621,00 - Decreto Federal nº 12.797/2025).

tools.name: brazil_energy_tariffs
tools.description: Queries residential, commercial, and industrial electricity tariffs across all Brazilian states and 100+ distribution concessionaires from ANEEL.

tools.name: brazil_freight_logistics
tools.description: Calculates regulatory minimum freight rates according to ANTT Resolution No. 5.867/2020 and its official updates.

tools.name: brazil_tax_anatomy
tools.description: Breaks down Brazilian consumption taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IPI, ISS) and provides forward-looking projections under Brazil's Tax Reform (EC 132/2023 - IBS/CBS).

tools.name: brazil_cost_of_living
tools.description: Provides comprehensive monthly cost of living indicators and economic basket valuations for all 27 Brazilian states and major metropolitan regions.

tools.name: brazil_lpg_gas_prices
tools.description: Queries weekly audited retail prices for 13kg residential cooking gas (GLP P-13) cylinders across Brazilian states and metropolitan areas from ANP.

tools.name: brazil_pharma_medicines
tools.description: Queries official pharmaceutical Maximum Consumer Price (PMC) ceilings established by CMED/ANVISA under Federal Law No. 10.742/2003 and Farmácia Popular do Brasil subsidies.

tools.name: brazil_list_states
tools.description: Returns metadata, IBGE codes, capital cities, macroeconomic regions, and active data coverage indicators for all 27 Brazilian Federative Units.

tools.name: brazil_compare_regions
tools.description: Performs comparative macroeconomic analysis between two Brazilian states or metropolitan regions across fuel prices, food baskets, electricity tariffs, and cost of living indices.

tools.name: brazil_contract_intent_a2a
tools.description: Issues a cryptographically signed Machine-to-Machine (A2A) Economic Intent Protocol and settlement guarantee with SHA-256 digital certificate valid for 24 hours.

prompts.name: analisar_orcamento_familiar
prompts.description: Roteiro cognitivo A2A para IA: cruza Cesta Básica (SEFAZ), Botijão GLP 13kg (ANP), Luz 150 kWh (ANEEL) e Salário Mínimo, calculando horímetro de trabalho e paridade de cocção.

prompts.name: auditar_viabilidade_logistica_antt
prompts.description: Roteiro A2A para frotas e embarcadores: cruza rota e eixos com o Piso Mínimo ANTT (Res. 5.867/2020) e calcula o impacto do Diesel S10 por kg de alimento.

prompts.name: raio_x_tributario_reforma
prompts.description: Simulação comparativa da transição tributária (ICMS/PIS/COFINS vs CBS/IBS - EC 132/2023).

prompts.name: auditar_preco_farmacia
prompts.description: Verificação pericial de Preço Máximo ao Consumidor (PMC CMED/ANVISA Lei 10.742/2003) e elegibilidade ao Programa Farmácia Popular.

prompts.name: analise_combustivel_frota
prompts.description: Auditoria de paridade térmica 70% Etanol vs Gasolina e cálculo de custo por quilômetro rodado com Diesel S10 da ANP.
